description: The brand's Klaviyo FLOWS (automations such as a welcome series, abandoned cart, post-purchase): name, status (live, manual, draft), trigger type, archived, created and updated, newest first. Filter by status or name. For a flow's opens, clicks and revenue use klaviyo_report with of:'flows'. Read-only, free. Needs Klaviyo connected (Connectors > Klaviyo, or connect_connector with a private API key).
name: list_klaviyo_flows
title: List Klaviyo flows
